tools.name: convert_mt940_statement
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to convert an MT940 file to Excel or CSV ("mt940 to excel", "mt940 converter", "convert mt940 to csv", "camt 053 to excel", "camt.053 converter") or check that a bank statement file adds up. Reads SWIFT MT940 (.sta, .mt940, .txt) or ISO 20022 camt.053 / camt.052 / camt.0
